name: DRAM 3141W
title: Playwriting
description: (Also offered as ENGL 3705W.) The writing, workshopping, revision, and structuring of plays. Key themes include character development, world-building, action, the voice of the playwright, incorporating dramaturgical feedback, revision, and cultivating consistent writing habits. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011; open to juniors or higher, others with instructor consent.
